args: GB200: paired aggregation effects on 1,375 validation structures
caption: Paired differences on identical generated pools. Error bars are 95% homology-group bootstrap intervals, without multiplicity adjustment. All planned structures are included; long-range metrics exclude structures with no native contact at sequence separation ≥24. F1 weighting and confidence tie-breaking were added after the ordinary-pool pilot and remain exploratory. No new reserved-test scores are shown.
